content.title: Can PacBio’s New CiFi Method Reshape PACB’s Innovation Story and Recurring Revenue Potential?
content.summary: PacBio recently announced CiFi, a community-developed method that integrates chromatin conformation capture with HiFi long-read sequencing to deliver chromosome-scale, haplotype-resolved genome assemblies from a single Revio run, as detailed in a Nature Communications paper from UC Davis researchers. By enabling reference-quality assemblies with fewer cells, libraries, and runs, CiFi could lower cost and sample barriers for genome biology, biodiversity, and functional genomics...
